meta.title: Lantern
meta.words: v3: the steel drum is now native, and a church bell answers at the phrase lines; otherwise as v2. v2, from your notes: the A13 is gone for a floating Cmaj7#11; no vibes: a steel drum in threes in their place, short and percussive, a note changing every eight bars; no clap and no pad: the stabs carry the chords, their filter opening and closing on an LFO into echo washes; the bass as it was.
